definitions.full: H621. Asenath אָֽסְנַת proper name, feminine wife of Joseph ( ᵐ5 Ἀσεννεθ , ᵐ5 L Ἀσσενεθ ; Egyptian, = belonging to (goddess) Neith (Thes); Cook Speaker's Comm. i. 479 proposes either As-Neit, favourite of Neith , or < Isis-Neit ) Gen 41:45 , 50 ; 46:20 .

occurrences.englishText: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
